purpose: Independently test source-record sensitivity of two already-qualified retrospective chemistry decisions; no new physical or economic claim.

cases.universe: fixed 10-source-substrate amidation and 253 ethanol ligand pairs; no changing denominators

semantics.interval: Each recorded yield independently has hypothetical additive symmetric absolute error ≤ epsilon percentage points; this is an adversarial sensitivity parameter, not a scientifically calibrated uncertainty bound.
semantics.amidation: For each substrate and assigned reaction condition c, guarantee observed(c)-epsilon >= 0.90*max(observed(c)-epsilon, max_{d!=c}(observed(d)+epsilon)); one fixed assignment for each source substrate.
semantics.ethanol: For each ligand pair, a selected substrate guarantees separation when abs(recorded_difference) >= 20+2*epsilon.
semantics.infeasibility: If any required row lacks a robust covering option, report infeasible for full declared universe with counterexample row. Never delete failures or redefine to covered-subset success.
semantics.comparison: Compare original fixed five-condition, six-substrate choices against full robust-cover optimum (when feasible). Verify solver certificates with separately authored existing independent checker; no claim of algorithmic novelty.

acceptance.source_identity: All pinned bytes and retained solver source must be verified.
acceptance.all_cases: Exactly six error radii, each with fixed original and reoptimized statuses; disclose if resource-bound, infeasible or checker-rejected.
acceptance.adversarial: Synthetic 2x2 and 2-ligand boundary counterexamples independently enumerated; one-case margins and fake input identities rejected.
acceptance.economics: Keep adopted utility, assay error, physical yield, true lab savings, actual model costs, buyer demand, revenue, and profit unknown.

ownership.boundary: Additive review-only experiment; no original source edits, no journal/Account, no production or release, no owner branch writes.
